metadata.name: Nazism
metadata.description: German National Socialism, 1920–1945: racial exclusion, dictatorship, expansionist war and an economy subordinated to rearmament. All racial claims are descriptions of the ideology’s false doctrines, not scientific findings.
metadata.scope: The NSDAP programme, Hitler’s 1936 economic memorandum and documented regime practice, interpreted through Holocaust scholarship. Programme rhetoric is distinguished from later private ownership under compulsory state direction. Membership and welfare were racially exclusionary; apparent social provisions are not presented as universal rights. This is a historical doctrine with no claimed incumbent exemplar.  Strict revision-2 re-audit: assess only source-supported positions on the exact questions. Unsupported empirical comparisons, modern technology analogies and institutional particulars remain unknown. Absence of doctrine is not a neutral position. This draft must not be used to calculate or publish a complete profile.
metadata.phrase: Racially exclusionary dictatorship and expansionist nationalism, with society and economic production subordinated to state power and war.
